/* selectSrvyListPop (참가신청서 의뢰내용 중 설문지관련문항 3개 조회) - Lee Hye Sun */ WITH TMP AS ( SELECT A.QUSTNB_MNG_NO --설문지관리번호 SBB110 , A.QUSTNB_TMPT_MNG_NO --설문지템플릿관리번호 SBB110 , B.TRPR_INFO_NO , B.APLY_RCPT_SN , Q1.QESITM_RSPNS_CN AS Q1 --문항응답내용 SBB220 , Q2.QESITM_RSPNS_CN AS Q2 --문항응답내용 SBB220 , Q3.QESITM_RSPNS_CN AS Q3 --문항응답내용 SBB220 FROM SBB110 A JOIN AFA100 B ON A.TRPR_INFO_NO = B.TRPR_INFO_NO AND A.APLY_RCPT_SN = B.APLY_RCPT_SN JOIN SBB300 C ON A.QUSTNB_MNG_NO = C.QUSTNB_MNG_NO AND C.QUSTNB_TMPT_MNG_NO = (SELECT ADDTNG_MNG_VALUE1 FROM SAC100 WHERE CMMNS_CD_ID = 'QUSTNB_KND_SE_CD' AND CMMNS_CD_VALUE = '006' AND ADDTNG_MNG_VALUE1 = C.QUSTNB_TMPT_MNG_NO) AND QESITM_SQNCE IN ('28' , '29', '30') JOIN SBB500 D ON A.QUSTNB_MNG_NO = D.QUSTNB_MNG_NO AND C.QUSTNB_TMPT_MNG_NO = D.QUSTNB_TMPT_MNG_NO AND D.SRVY_RSPNS_MNG_NO = (SELECT MAX(SRVY_RSPNS_MNG_NO) FROM SBB500 WHERE QUSTNB_MNG_NO = A.QUSTNB_MNG_NO) LEFT JOIN SBB220 Q1 --도움내용 ON C.QESITM_MNG_NO = Q1.QESITM_MNG_NO AND Q1.QESITM_MNG_NO = (SELECT ADDTNG_MNG_VALUE1 FROM SAC100 WHERE CMMNS_CD_ID = 'PTCPT_REQSTD_SRVY_CN_SE_CD' AND CMMNS_CD_VALUE = '001' AND ADDTNG_MNG_VALUE1 = Q1.QESITM_MNG_NO) AND D.SRVY_RSPNS_MNG_NO = Q1.SRVY_RSPNS_MNG_NO LEFT JOIN SBB220 Q2 --의뢰기간치료목표 ON C.QESITM_MNG_NO = Q2.QESITM_MNG_NO AND Q2.QESITM_MNG_NO = (SELECT ADDTNG_MNG_VALUE1 FROM SAC100 WHERE CMMNS_CD_ID = 'PTCPT_REQSTD_SRVY_CN_SE_CD' AND CMMNS_CD_VALUE = '002' AND ADDTNG_MNG_VALUE1 = Q2.QESITM_MNG_NO) AND D.SRVY_RSPNS_MNG_NO = Q2.SRVY_RSPNS_MNG_NO LEFT JOIN SBB220 Q3 --필요도움내용 ON C.QESITM_MNG_NO = Q3.QESITM_MNG_NO --문항관리번호 AND Q3.QESITM_MNG_NO = (SELECT ADDTNG_MNG_VALUE1 FROM SAC100 WHERE CMMNS_CD_ID = 'PTCPT_REQSTD_SRVY_CN_SE_CD' AND CMMNS_CD_VALUE = '003' AND ADDTNG_MNG_VALUE1 = Q3.QESITM_MNG_NO) AND D.SRVY_RSPNS_MNG_NO = Q3.SRVY_RSPNS_MNG_NO
WHERE A.TRPR_INFO_NO = #{TRPR_INFO_NO} AND A.APLY_RCPT_SN = #{APLY_RCPT_SN} ) SELECT MAX(A.QUSTNB_MNG_NO) AS QUSTNB_MNG_NO ,MAX(A.QUSTNB_TMPT_MNG_NO) AS QUSTNB_TMPT_MNG_NO ,MAX(A.TRPR_INFO_NO) AS TRPR_INFO_NO ,MAX(A.APLY_RCPT_SN) AS APLY_RCPT_SN ,(SELECT Q1 FROM TMP WHERE Q1 IS NOT NULL) AS RQST_CS_CN ,(SELECT Q2 FROM TMP WHERE Q2 IS NOT NULL) AS RQST_INST_MDLRT_GOAL_CN ,(SELECT Q3 FROM TMP WHERE Q3 IS NOT NULL) AS NOW_NEED_HELP_CN FROM TMP A

/* selectdsFamInfoImsy (참가신청서 중 가족사항) - Lee Hye Sun */ SELECT C.TRPR_INFO_NO , (SELECT CMMNS_CD_VALUE_NM FROM SAC100 WHERE CMMNS_CD_ID = 'FAM_REL_SE_CD' AND CMMNS_CD_VALUE = C.FAM_REL_SE_CD) AS FAM_REL_SE_CD , C.FAM_REL_SE_CD , DEC_B64(C.FAM_TRPR_NM_ENCPT) AS FAM_TRPR_NM_ENCPT , '만 ' || TRUNC(MONTHS_BETWEEN(SYSDATE, C.FAM_TRPR_BRTH_YMD) /12) || '세' AS FAM_AGE , (SELECT CMMNS_CD_VALUE_NM FROM SAC100 WHERE CMMNS_CD_ID = 'SXDC_SE_CD' AND CMMNS_CD_VALUE = C.SXDC_SE_CD) AS SXDC_SE_CD , C.SXDC_SE_CD , (SELECT CMMNS_CD_VALUE_NM FROM SAC100 WHERE CMMNS_CD_ID = 'OCCP_CL_SE_CD' AND CMMNS_CD_VALUE = C.OCCP_CL_SE_CD) AS OCCP_CL_SE_CD , C.OCCP_CL_SE_CD , C.LIVTGT_YN , DEC_B64(C.MBL_TELNO_ENCPT) AS MBL_TELNO_ENCPT , C.RM_CN FROM AFA100 A LEFT JOIN SEA200 B ON A.TRPR_INFO_NO = B.TRPR_INFO_NO LEFT JOIN SEA210 C ON A.TRPR_INFO_NO = C.TRPR_INFO_NO WHERE A.TRPR_INFO_NO = #{TRPR_INFO_NO} AND A.APLY_RCPT_SN = #{APLY_RCPT_SN}

/* Park.Seoung.Won */ /* 사례대상자 목록 조회(의뢰정보) */ T13.APLY_RCPT_SN AS APLY_RCPT_SN /* 신청접수일련번호 */ , T2.CASE_MNG_NO AS CASE_MNG_NO /* 사례관리번호 */ , T2.CASE_MNG_ODRNO AS CASE_MNG_ODRNO /* 사례관리차수 */ , T3.TRPR_INFO_NO AS TRPR_INFO_NO /* 대상자정보번호 */ , DEC_B64(NVL(T4.FLNM_ENCPT,T3.TRPR_NM_ENCPT)) AS TRPR_NM_ENCPT /* 대상자명 */ , TO_CHAR(TO_DATE(T3.TRPR_BRTH_YMD), 'YYYY-MM-DD') AS TRPR_BRTH_YMD /* 대상자출생일자 */ , CASE WHEN T4.INDV_IDNTFC_NO IS NULL THEN T3.SXDC_SE_CD ELSE T4.SXDC_SE_CD END AS SXDC_SE_CD /* 대상자성별구분코드 */ , T2.YNGBGS_SE_NO AS YNGBGS_SE_NO /* 청소년구분번호 */ , DEC_B64(T6.FLNM_ENCPT) AS FLNM_ENCPT /* 담당자명 */ , T7.INST_NM AS INST_NM /* 담당기관명 */ , T3.CASE_TRPR_TYPE_SE_CD AS CASE_TRPR_TYPE_SE_CD /* 사례대상자유형구분코드 */ , T2.CASE_PRGRS_STTS_SE_CD AS CASE_PRGRS_STTS_SE_CD /* 사례진행상태구분코드 */ , T2.UNT_TASKWK_SE_CD AS UNT_TASKWK_SE_CD /* 단위업무구분코드 */ , (SELECT UP_CMMNS_CD_VALUE FROM SAC100 WHERE CMMNS_CD_ID = 'CASE_PRGRS_STTS_SE_CD' AND CMMNS_CD_VALUE = T2.CASE_PRGRS_STTS_SE_CD ) AS CASE_PRGRS_STTS_TYPE_SE_CD /* 사례진행상태유형구분코드 */ /* 의뢰정보목록_ 사업연도, 서비스실행사업번호, 사례시작, 종료일자, 종결구분, 종결사유구분 */
, TO_CHAR(TO_DATE(T2.CASE_BGNG_YMD), 'YYYY-MM-DD') AS CASE_BGNG_YMD /* 사례시작일자 */ , TO_CHAR(TO_DATE(T2.CASE_TRMN_YMD), 'YYYY-MM-DD') AS CASE_TRMN_YMD /* 사례종결일자 */ , T11.BIZ_YR AS BIZ_YR /* 사업연도 */ , T1.SRVC_EXCN_BIZ_NO AS SRVC_EXCN_BIZ_NO /* 서비스실행사업번호 */ , T12.TRMN_CS_SE_CD AS TRMN_CS_SE_CD /* 종결사유구분코드 */ , T12.TRMN_SE_CD AS TRMN_SE_CD /* 종결구분코드 */ , T2.ALTMNT_GROUP_SCLAS_SE_CD AS ALTMNT_GROUP_SCLAS_SE_CD /* 배정그룹구분코드 */
FROM AFA100 T1 LEFT JOIN SEB100 T2 ON T2.TRPR_INFO_NO = T1.TRPR_INFO_NO JOIN SEA200 T3 ON T3.TRPR_INFO_NO = T2.TRPR_INFO_NO LEFT JOIN SCA300 T4 ON T4.INDV_IDNTFC_NO = T3.INDV_IDNTFC_NO LEFT JOIN SEB150 T5 ON T5.CASE_MNG_NO = T2.CASE_MNG_NO AND T5.CASE_MNG_ODRNO = T2.CASE_MNG_ODRNO AND T5.PCHPRS_YN = 'Y' LEFT JOIN SCA100 T6 ON T6.ENFSN_NO = T5.CASE_PIC_NO LEFT JOIN SAA000 T7 ON T7.INST_NO = T1.RSFR_INST_NO LEFT JOIN AFA410 T8 ON T8.CASE_MNG_NO = T2.CASE_MNG_NO AND T8.CASE_MNG_ODRNO = T2.CASE_MNG_ODRNO LEFT JOIN SEB120 T9 ON T9.CASE_MNG_NO = T8.CASE_MNG_NO AND T9.CASE_MNG_ODRNO = T8.CASE_MNG_ODRNO AND T9.DEL_YN != 'Y' LEFT JOIN SDA420 T10 ON T10.SRVC_EXCN_BIZ_NO = T1.SRVC_EXCN_BIZ_NO LEFT JOIN SDA400 T11 ON T11.SRVC_BIZ_NO = T10.SRVC_BIZ_NO LEFT JOIN ( SELECT B.* ,ROW_NUMBER() OVER(PARTITION BY B.CASE_MNG_NO, B.CASE_MNG_ODRNO ORDER BY B.CASE_TRMN_NO DESC) AS RN FROM SEC100 A LEFT JOIN SEC100 B ON B.CASE_MNG_NO = A.CASE_MNG_NO AND B.CASE_MNG_NO = A.CASE_MNG_NO AND B.TRMN_SRNG_RESULT_SE_CD = '01' WHERE A.TRMN_SRNG_RESULT_SE_CD = '02' )T12 /* 사례종결 */ ON T12.CASE_MNG_NO = T2.CASE_MNG_NO AND T12.CASE_MNG_ODRNO = T2.CASE_MNG_ODRNO AND T12.RN=1 JOIN AFA120 T13 ON T13.TRPR_INFO_NO = T1.TRPR_INFO_NO AND T13.APLY_RCPT_SN = T13.APLY_RCPT_SN WHERE 1=1 AND T2.UNT_TASKWK_SE_CD = #{UNT_TASKWK_SE_CD} AND (T1.RSFR_INST_NO = #{INST_NO} OR #{INST_TYPE_SE_CD} IN ('1')) AND T11.BIZ_YR = #{BIZ_YR}
AND T2.YNGBGS_SE_NO LIKE '%' || #{YNGBGS_STTS_LCLAS_SE_CD} || '%'

AND T6.FLNM_ENCPT = ENC_B64(#{FLNM_ENCPT})
AND T10.SRVC_EXCN_BIZ_NO LIKE #{SRVC_EXCN_BIZ_NO} || '%'
